ratings_why.fun: From Tier 4 on, every slot is a timing choice (who speaks while you play, sell and end the turn) and the fight is a queue you script; Tiers 1-3 are thin, one text on the board, so it stops at 7.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because it flips the auto-battler default that every card speaks: only one Lemming talks at a time, so slot order becomes both a recruit-phase timing puzzle and an in-fight line of succession, which no tribe today does.

verdict_why: The rule works and the combos are rich, but Herald of the Herd copying another Herald, or texts that say "this", needs one rule line to be readable.

points.text: Herald next to another Herald is unstated: does the copied "your next Lemming" count from the first Herald (a loop) or from the second? Also say that "this" in copied text (Trailbreaker's swap, Lemen's stats) means Herald.
Tiers 1-3 have one real succession trick (Squeaker) and the rest wait at the back. One cheap Tier 2 Take the Lead or swap card would let the queue matter from the first fights.
Herald as Front with Trailbreaker next is a hidden gem: it swaps back, Trailbreaker swaps it forward again, and Herald now copies a different next Lemming. Worth listing in the Relay build.
Kit-Minder fights Banner-Bearer and Herding Elder for the one End of Turn slot and loses most turns. Making it Loud, or having it act when a Kit takes the lead, would give it a place.
Gerd turning enemy attacks into a queue is what makes Next-Cliff Pilgrim and Cantor of the Edge reliable; a second, cheaper way to steer attacks at the Front would open the Cliff Cult before Tier 5.

standouts.why: Herald of the Herd turns positioning into a copy machine: in front of an End of Turn card while recruiting, in front of a Take the Lead card in the fight.
Gerd the Shouter makes the enemy kill your leaders in the order you set, which powers the whole Cliff Cult and is a trap in the Matriarch.
Old Mother Lemen makes blank Kits into copies of her, turns Kit-Minder into a deliberate anti-synergy and makes guarding one slot the plan.

weakest.why: Kit-Minder spends the End of Turn Front on a small Kit buff, and Lemen overwrites it anyway.
Banner-Bearer is a plain stat drip with no decision beyond being the End of Turn Front.

flags.note: Herald copying Herald, and copied text that says "this", can't be read as written.
Cantor, The Front Lemming and golden Brother Onward stack to a large in-fight spike; it resets each fight but is worth the owner's eye.
With Herding Council, a Kit that is also a Front copies Lemen's Banner-included stats and may get the Banner again on top.
